decisive_items: High-intensity areas in bilateral lenticular nucleus with lentiform fork sign
response.rationale: The combination of high-intensity areas in bilateral lenticular nucleus with lentiform fork sign on T2-weighted brain MRI and the presence of a lactate peak on MRS are more characteristic of Leigh syndrome than the other options.

rejected.why: Normal dopamine transporter scan contradicts Parkinson's disease diagnosis
Normal vitamin B1 levels contradict Wernicke's encephalopathy diagnosis
Not enough evidence to support Wilson's disease diagnosis
Although mitochondrial disease is possible, the specific imaging findings are more characteristic of Leigh syndrome
